name: Prodigy Ventures Inc.
summary: Prodigy Ventures Inc. provides technology services to financial institutions and other large enterprises in Canada and the United States. It offers consulting services for strategy, design, project management, application development, cloud migration, and testing. The company also develops mobile enterprise and payments applications for banks and other enterprise customers; and offers digital transformation services, such as strategy, architecture, design, project management, agile development, quality engineering, and staff augmentation. In addition, it provides IDVerifact, a SaaS platform that enables the consumption of digital identity assets into critical business processes for enterprise clients. The company is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
